title: Razor1911
summary: Razor 1911's eponymous demo celebrating 40 years of the group, which won first place at the Revision 2026 demo competition and the public's choice award. It is a retrospective of keygen and warez scene culture with chiptune music.
why: HN commenters point to it as an impressive showpiece of the demoscene and a nostalgic career retrospective of a legendary group.

quote.text: This Razor1911 career retrospective demo from Revision was pretty impressive
